documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.subtitle: How the AI Router works — credits, the auto model, and authentication.
documentation.overview: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes every request to the cheapest, fastest model that can answer. You send prompts; the router picks the provider. No model pinning, no vendor lock-in.
documentation.credits: Every request is billed per 1,000 tokens against your credit balance. Input, cached, and output tokens are counted. Top up any time from Billing — credits never expire within the billing period.
documentation.auto: Always send model: "auto". The router matches each prompt to the best available model by intent, latency, and cost, with automatic fallback if a provider is rate-limited or down.
documentation.auth: Authenticate with your dashboard token or an API key. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer <token> or X-Api-Key: sk-... on every request to /chat/completions.
documentation.fallback: If the primary provider fails, the router retries the next best model automatically. Every request is logged with cost and latency in Usage.

integration.title: Integration
integration.subtitle: Drop-in with any OpenAI SDK. Change only the baseURL — everything else stays the same.
integration.note: Replace $BASE with your endpoint and use your API key (sk-...) from the API Keys page — no login required. The model is always auto.
